direct_booking.description_es: 10% de descuento reservando directamente con nosotros (no a través de terceros como PADI)
direct_booking.description_en: 10% discount booking directly with us (not through third parties like PADI)

second_day.description_es: 10% de descuento para segundo día de buceo
second_day.description_en: 10% discount for second day of diving

group_discount.description_es: 10% de descuento para grupos de 5 personas o más, que se suma al 10% de descuento online (20% total reservando online)
group_discount.description_en: 10% discount for groups of 5 or more people, which stacks with the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online)

roverd_web_discount.description_es: 10% de descuento adicional reservando a través del sistema ROVERD en la página web
roverd_web_discount.description_en: Additional 10% discount booking through the ROVERD system on the website

colombian_special.description_es: Bono adicional para locales colombianos. Contactar por WhatsApp para obtener descuento.
colombian_special.description_en: Additional bonus for local Colombians. Contact via WhatsApp to get discount.

non_cumulative.es: Los descuentos no son acumulables excepto en casos especiales autorizados por el staff o donde se indique explícitamente lo contrario (ej: grupo + online sí se suman)
non_cumulative.en: Discounts are not cumulative except in special cases authorized by staff or where explicitly stated otherwise (e.g. group + online do stack)
